CLAUDE_CHECKPOINT.md - Session Summary (December 5, 2025)

Source: CLAUDE_CHECKPOINT.md

Project: statues_named_john

Current Status:

  • Deployment issues related to pkgdown vignettes not updating correctly on GitHub Pages have been addressed.
  • This included fixing:
    • Missing plot categories (‘Male’, ‘Animal’) in the “Representation Analysis” section.
    • Missing “Animal” and “Unknown” tabs in the “Top Names by Gender” section.
    • Incorrect limerick formatting in the vignette and README.
  • The root cause was identified as pkgdown rebuilding vignettes in CI with empty data due to a missing _targets store, and documentation_plan.R not copying vignette image assets (_files directory) to the vignettes/ folder.
  • These fixes involved:
    • Modifying .github/workflows/pkgdown.yml to prevent pkgdown from rebuilding articles in CI (override = list(articles = NULL)).
    • Updating R/tar_plans/documentation_plan.R to correctly copy all generated vignette assets (_files directory).
    • Updating limericks in inst/qmd/memorial-analysis.qmd and inst/qmd/README.qmd to use <br> for line breaks.
    • All changes have been committed, pushed, and merged to the main branch.
    • The latest GitHub Actions workflow on main has completed successfully.

Issues Resolved/Closed:

  • #75: Feat: Add ‘Animal’ and ‘Unknown’ tabs to Top Names by Gender (Completed & Closed)
  • #77: Bug: Representation Analysis plot in vignette is missing ‘Male’ and ‘Animal’ categories (Completed & Closed)
  • #69: Bug: Representation Analysis plot missing ‘Male’ category (Closed as Duplicate of #77)
  • #67: QA: Generate Data Samples for Manual Inspection and Variable Discovery (Completed & Closed)
  • #78: Bug: Limerick formatting is incorrect (missing line breaks) (Completed & Closed)

Issues Raised:

  • #76: Chore: Migrate Nix Troubleshooting Wiki Content and Cross-Reference
  • #79: Chore: Automate README.md rendering via targets
  • #80: Docs: Explicitly document pkgdown ‘override articles’ configuration in AGENTS.md and DEVELOPER_WORKFLOW.md
  • #81: Feat: Display source code for targets in vignettes
  • #82: Chore: Migrate .qmd vignette sources to standard ‘vignettes/’ directory

Next Steps (Awaiting User Confirmation):

  • Confirm Website Update: User to verify that the deployed website at https://johngavin.github.io/statues_named_john/articles/memorial-analysis.html now correctly displays:
    • Title: “Comparing London Memorials: Johns, Women, and Dogs (Updated)”
    • Limerick: Formatted with proper line breaks.
    • “Top Names by Gender” section: Tabs for “Female”, “Male”, “Animal”, and “Unknown”.
    • “Representation Analysis” plot: Shows all 5 categories (Male, Female, Unknown, Animal, Other).

Next Agent Actions (Once Confirmed):

  • Proceed to address outstanding issues, typically starting with those in Group A (Wiki/Documentation Management) or Group B (CI/CD & Workflow Improvements), or the newly raised issues, ordered by difficulty.
  • Specifically, address #80 (document pkgdown override) and #82 (.qmd migration) as they relate to recent workflow issues.
